corrected_preflights.note: These two failed untimed baseline preflights are retained separately from the successful formal benchmark and correctness runs. The final benchmark uses the independently correct modulo-key shape.

cast_regression.note: This targeted correction proof used an intermediate combined source. The final full query/execute audits supersede it.

provenance.note: The successful offline adapter build found all engine/dependency artifacts fresh without compiling. Only the current conformance harness was compiled against that release rlib; rustc enforces crate metadata compatibility.

rust_build.note: The root-package Cargo attempts were stopped at their explicit RSS guards. The successful build compiled only the current conformance harness against the already validated, unchanged release engine artifacts.

node_guard.note: The 16 GiB virtual ceiling prevented the Node owner worker from completing startup. The same auto-locking probe and all file regressions pass with 64 GiB virtual space; the resident-memory cap remains 512 MiB.

shared_regressions.rss_sampling_note: The enforced resident cap is512MiB. A zero sampled peak means the tiny worker exited before its first sample; it is not a measurement of zero memory use.

correctness.policy: Every SQL record uses the selected API. Query collection is external for every record. No failure allowlist, mixed API routing or un-authored skips are accepted.

binding.statistic: Each source ABBA quartet uses the mean of two process medians; each process median is five samples divided by iterations. Microseconds per complete query. The actual binding comparison is a separate fresh process per API.

cross_memory.statistic: Single fresh process per core, median of five samples, microseconds per complete query.
cross_memory.validation_scope: Rendered-value checksums and row counts only. These adapters use their existing collectors, including Ruby Rows#rows; exact costs and column metadata are independently checked against the Rust Ruby package in the binding reports.

profiles.note: Diagnostic timing and allocations use the existing execute_prepared/eager Result#rows collector. All timing precedes TracePoint and ObjectSpace tracing; these timing observations are separate from the externally drained source ABBA measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source/runtime comparison of all four APIs, memory and file storage, exact outputs/metadata/cost/error prefixes, binding-sensitive winners and invalidation. Remaining weak references after GC are recorded as observed, without assuming the VM releases them.
